Script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Set-Location 'F:\.codex\worktrees\ecs-relations-worker-3\SomeEngine.Next'
$directory='artifacts/relations-measurements/focused-native-r39'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $directory -Force|Out-Null
$stages=[Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
$commands=@(
    [pscustomobject]@{Name='relations-output';Arguments=@('test','tests/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.Tests/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations.Tests.csproj','-c','Release','--no-restore','--filter','FullyQualifiedName~ChainedRulesForwardRefStructOutputAndStopState|FullyQualifiedName~BinaryFiltersForwardRefStructOutputAndEarlyStop|FullyQualifiedName~KeyBucketsForwardRefStructOutputAndEarlyStop|FullyQualifiedName~EightPositionsReturnTheEighthEntityAndForwardEarlyStopState|FullyQualifiedName~BitmapFiltersForwardCountExistenceAndRefStructEarlyStop|FullyQualifiedName~EndpointRulesKeepEdgeRowsAndForwardEarlyOutputState')},
    [pscustomobject]@{Name='physics-parallel';Arguments=@('test','tests/SomeEngine.Physics.Tests/SomeEngine.Physics.Tests.csproj','-c','Release','--no-restore','--filter','FullyQualifiedName~SpatialParallelTests')}
)
$observed=Get-Date -AsUTC -Format o
git diff -- src/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations/IQueryRelationOutput.cs src/SomeEngine.ECS.Relations/RelationQuery.cs src/SomeEngine.Physics/CollisionPairBuffer.cs
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
foreach($command in $commands){
    $start=Get-Date -AsUTC -Format o
    & dotnet @($command.Arguments)
    $exit=$LASTEXITCODE
    $end=Get-Date -AsUTC -Format o
    $stages.Add([pscustomobject]@{Name=$command.Name;Executable='dotnet';Arguments=$command.Arguments;StartedAtUtc=$start;FinishedAtUtc=$end;ExitCode=$exit})
    $stages|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5|Set-Content -LiteralPath "$directory/behavior-stages.json" -Encoding utf8
    if($exit -ne 0){exit $exit}
}
Write-Output ('BEHAVIOR_STAGES '+($stages|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress))
exit 0
